description: This Python module handles SQLite database connection, schema initialization, and user setup for a backend API. It includes functions for database path resolution, connection management, schema creation, and seed data insertion, with a focus on robustness and backward compatibility.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Authentication service used for password hashing during user seed process.

methods.name: _default_db_path
methods.description: Computes a deterministic default database path based on the container root.

methods.name: _fallback_db_path
methods.description: Provides a writable fallback path in /tmp for the database.

methods.name: _connect_sqlite
methods.description: Creates a SQLite connection with foreign key enforcement and row factory set.

methods.name: _ensure_parent_dir
methods.description: Ensures the parent directory exists for a given database path.

methods.name: _ensure_system_user
methods.description: Ensures a 'system' user exists in the users table, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: get_db_path
methods.description: Returns the database file path, resolving environment variables and relative paths.

methods.name: get_connection
methods.description: Provides a singleton SQLite connection, attempting fallback modes if initial connection fails.

methods.name: close_connection
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: db_status
methods.description: Checks database connectivity and returns status info without raising exceptions.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, creating tables and indexes, and applies migrations.

methods.name: seed_test_users
methods.description: Seeds predefined test users with hashed passwords for development/testing.
